Examples include 01cf9986 PASS, 2cb98eac PASS_FOR_REVIEW, 49894e18 FAIL, 79ddb67c BLOCKED, and 855ef00a BLOCKED. Record 84cee038 uses the placeholder <authorized-actor> and generic authority authorized lifecycle actor, so the proposal is not an exact command bound to named authority.
